command:
cd /srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, shutil, stat, tempfile
src_root=b'imported'
dst_root=b'converted'
collisions=[]
copied=[]
os.makedirs(dst_root, exist_ok=True)
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src_root):
    rel=os.path.relpath(root, src_root)
    rel_parts=[] if rel==b'.' else rel.split(b'/')
    dst_dir=dst_root
    for part in rel_parts:
        dst_dir=os.path.join(dst_dir, part.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8'))
    if os.path.lexists(dst_dir):
        if not os.path.isdir(dst_dir):
            collisions.append((root, dst_dir, 'destination path is not a directory'))
            dirs[:] = []
            continue
    else:
        os.mkdir(dst_dir)
    for name in files:
        src=os.path.join(root,name)
        utf8_name=name.decode('latin-1').encode('utf-8')
        dst=os.path.join(dst_dir,utf8_name)
        if os.path.lexists(dst):
            collisions.append((src,dst,'destination already exists'))
            continue
        try:
            fd=os.open(dst, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL, stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(src, follow_symlinks=False).st_mode))
            with open(src,'rb') as inf, os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as outf:
                shutil.copyfileobj(inf,outf)
            shutil.copystat(src,dst,follow_symlinks=False)
            copied.append((src,dst))
        except Exception:
            try: os.unlink(dst)
            except OSError: pass
            raise
report='conversion-collisions.log'
tmp=report+'.tmp'
with open(tmp,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as f:
    f.write('Filename conversion collision report\n')
    f.write('Source encoding: ISO-8859-1; destination encoding: UTF-8\n')
    for src,dst,reason in collisions:
        f.write('COLLISION: source={} destination={} reason={}\n'.format(src.decode('latin-1'),dst.decode('utf-8'),reason))
os.replace(tmp,report)
for src,dst in copied:
    print('COPIED source_hex={} destination_utf8={}'.format(src.hex(),dst.decode('utf-8')))
for src,dst,reason in collisions:
    print('COLLISION source_hex={} destination_utf8={} reason={}'.format(src.hex(),dst.decode('utf-8'),reason))
print('SUMMARY copied={} collisions={}'.format(len(copied),len(collisions)))
PY
